On **5 October 2026**, **Bruna Maria de Paula Campos** presented her Master's
qualification in the Graduate Programme in Animal Biology at UFMS.

Bruna's project asks how multiple facets of frog biodiversity respond to
urbanisation across the Brazilian Atlantic Forest, using a macroecological
approach.
